selectionReason: The next fifteen, in source-row order, of the absent frozen rows at least one of whose KANJIDIC2 readings is used by an existing word article that declares the kanji (an automatic alignment of each word's kana against the kanji's readings), the rule announced on issue 60 after batch 136. No word article is added: 20 existing articles each gain one link to a new card. A card quizzes each reading that a declaring word article uses, unless the pinned JMdict marks the spelling as ateji or the reading as gikun; name-only readings are never quizzed; a reading type with no such reading gets an empty quizzed list. All fifteen pass, so none is set aside. Two selected readings are outside the official Joyo table (逸 そ.れる in 逸れる and 遂 つい.に in 遂に), and 遣's three articles (仮名遣い, 小遣い, 言葉遣い) read づかい, selected as the KANJIDIC2 reading -づか.い. Three existing cards (仮 故 響) also change in their remarks, four edits in all: a sentence that said 遣 or 郷 had no card here now links it, or is removed. No other line of a word article or an existing card changes. 31 rows of the 106-row group, 11 rows whose declaring articles use none of their KANJIDIC2 readings, and 644 rows with no declaring article remain.

review.execution: All four runs started after the previous one ended. initial-gpt and both confirmations had at most one tool call in flight. initial-claude issued two pairs of read-only view calls at once, inside the packet (20:23:08 UTC: repo/docs/content-format.md lines 86-155 with snapshot/kanji/趣.md; 20:26:36 UTC: snapshot/kanji/郡.md with 郷.md); its report disclosed the second pair and said its earlier turns had been compacted out of its context. initial-claude also wrote a temporary helper script, reports-152/_jm.py, that only parsed the packet's JMdict extract, and deleted it before writing its report, as the report discloses; the audit's two write-like shell commands and two paths outside the packet are that script and its folder. The initial-gpt audit flags one write outside the report path; this is a false positive: the report was written through a relative path that resolves to reports-152/initial-gpt.md. Each confirmation was a fresh agent of the same model family, given the author's statement on its family's initial report and allowed to read the original packet and that report. Both families confirmed the same final commit b81299f3, which was written before either confirmation started.

Some readings on the cards rest on a single dictionary entry or a Kanjipedia-only entry and are labelled as source-only where they appear; the card text is the authority for which.

Some titles share an English word with existing titles in another sense and are not excluded from each other's quiz options, except where a Notes bullet on the card says otherwise. Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology; component and stroke statements follow the pinned KanjiVG revision.
